The '''Northward Park''' was a park in [[Vaklin Zenith]]. It was planted with cuttings from the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Uro Koo]]. It was destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during the [[Vaklin insurgency]].
